discription: A basic pulse wave synth with an amplitude ADSR envelope and a static low-pass filter. Adjustable pulse width, cutoff, and resonance.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, pulseWidth=0.5, cutoff=8000, rq=0.5; var sig; var env = EnvGen.ar(Env.adsr(0.01, 0.1, 0.8, 1.0, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2); sig = Pulse.ar(freq, pulseWidth); sig = RLPF.ar(sig, cutoff, rq); sig = sig * amp * env; Out.ar(out, sig ! 2); }
